description.value: Jang Mo Jib is a Korean restaurant located on the second floor of 808 Bute Street in Vancouver's West End, with a sizeable indoor dining room and outdoor seating. With a listed capacity of 200, it is a substantial sit-down establishment serving traditional Korean cuisine. The restaurant offers both delivery and takeout, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through the neighbourhood.
